summary: Built-in become plugins are already enabled. Custom ones go in a become_plugins directory next to the play, inside a role, or in a become plugin path set in ansible.cfg.
questions: Do I need to enable the sudo become plugin?
Where do I put a custom privilege escalation plugin?
Can a role ship its own become plugin?

answer_card.title: Enabling custom become plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Shipped become plugins are already enabled. To add a custom one, place it in:
- a `become_plugins` directory next to your play
- a role
- a become plugin directory configured in `ansible.cfg`
